🧘 End Sleepless Nights & Anxiety with Pure Sound Healing Frequencies
Tired of synthetic, low-quality meditation music that doesn't work? Tibetan Bowls Solfeggio Studio is the definitive, ad-free tool for crafting powerful sound baths and custom zen meditation music.

We provide high-definition, authentic recordings of Tibetan singing bowls and crystal singing bowls tuned to the therapeutic Solfeggio Frequencies. This powerful combination offers maximum control for mindfulness, stress relief, and frequency healing.

✨ The Ultimate Solfeggio Frequency Mixer
Take complete control of your deep relaxation session. While other sound apps play one frequency at a time, Studio lets you layer and blend up to 10 frequencies simultaneously. Effortlessly create custom soundscapes by combining different Solfeggio tones with adjustable volume levels.
🔑 Key Features for Healing Practitioners & Sleep Seekers:

* Multi-Frequency Layering: Mix up to 10 Solfeggio tones to target complex healing intentions (e.g., 528 Hz for transformation, 417 Hz for undoing situations).
* True Tibetan Bowls: Unlike apps that use synthesized tones, we provide genuine, high-fidelity recordings of singing bowls and gongs.
* Integrated Meditation Timer: Set custom session lengths for your gong meditation and sound bath to ensure deep, uninterrupted sleep aid sounds.
* Battery Saver Mode: Play screen-off to save your battery life during long meditation or deep sleep cycles.
* Fully Supported & Free: App is completely free yet fully supported and advertising-free—a vital tool for your well-being.

✅ Perfect For:
* Anyone seeking anxiety relief music and stress reduction.
* Users looking for a high-quality, free sleep aid or sleep sounds.
* Meditation students and practitioners who need a customizable frequency generator and gong sounds.


* Creating a personalized soundtrack for deep relaxation and sound healing.
